text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear body paragraphs with reasons and examples","quality":"organization","description":"The essay groups its ideas into a recognizable introduction, body, and conclusion so the argument is easier to follow."},{"evidence":"\"What happens when the computers crash though?\" and \"If a driver gets bored...they fall alseep\"","quality":"development","description":"The essay expands its claims with specific scenarios that explain why the writer thinks driverless cars could be unsafe."},{"evidence":"\"As quoted from the article\" and direct quotation of the boredom question","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay makes more effective use of the source article by quoting and tying a point back to it."},{"evidence":"\"I believe that we can reach a happy median without giving computers full control\"","quality":"nuance","description":"The essay shows a more balanced stance by acknowledging benefits and proposing a middle ground instead of only attacking the idea."}]}
